cold_open.hook: Russian gold is flooding Hong Kong. Western sanctions just rewrote the entire bullion playbook.

markets.macro_note: Tech leads, financials mixed, yields holding steady as equities defy gravity.

big_story.story_title: Russian gold floods Hong Kong as Western sanctions redraw bullion trade
big_story.angle: Sanctions meant to isolate Russia are instead creating a parallel bullion infrastructure centered in Hong Kong—a real-time case study in how capital finds the cracks in the global financial system.

quick_hits.angle: Narrow market breadth (mega-cap tech vs. everything else) is a classic setup for violent repricing—either a melt-up or a washout.

odd_thing.joke_angle: OpenAI's 'rogue' bots may have crashed Wikipedia—the irony of AI trained on Wikipedia now potentially breaking Wikipedia is almost too perfect.

sign_off.callback_target: Russian gold in Hong Kong—the sanctions loophole that nobody wanted to talk about until it was already happening.
